rules.name: Lakehouse Schema Names Must Be Snake-Case Identifiers
rules.description: Returns schema names that are not lower snake_case from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA.

sqlquery: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS SchemaName FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE LOWER(SCHEMA_NAME) NOT IN ('dbo','information_schema') AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT LIKE '[a-z]%' OR PATINDEX('%[^a-z0-9_]%', SCHEMA_NAME) > 0
